name: Otterball Antics
description: Create a 1/1 blue and red Otter creature token with prowess. If this spell was cast from anywhere other than your hand, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature. Flashback {3}{U}.
couldNotDerive: That the counter goes on the just-created Otter token, not the sorcery itself -- Defined$Remembered resolves to thing:self instead of the token.
The wasCastFromYourHand dynamic condition gating the counter.
notes: Flashback and the base token-creation reconstruct correctly. Two real gaps: (1) Defined$Remembered (referring back to the just-created, remembered token from earlier in this same chain) resolves to the wrong thing (self, not the token) -- same Defined$<sibling-reference> family as ParentTarget/Targeted/Enchanted, a new instance. (2) ConditionPresent$ Card.wasCast+!wasCastFromYourHand (a real, narrow dynamic condition -- was this specific spell cast from a non-hand zone) has no representation -- a new, narrow condition shape distinct from the gift-promised/threshold ones already handled. Neither fixed this round.
